subject: Every string the project.export surface exposes to AX in zh-CN
question: What labels does Logic show on project.export in zh-CN, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in zh-CN whose project.export rows carry the same 52 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Navigated and restored. For each surface the plan names, one menu item or one element was pressed (found by a label set's own strings, a menu identifier or a key equivalent -- never by a coordinate), the window or sheet or menu that appeared was read to depth 10, and it was closed through its own cancel or close button. The window set and the project's modification time were read before and after each step and had to be equal. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file.

conclusion: On this host in zh-CN, project.export exposes 58 elements carrying 52 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Opened by one menu press or one element press each, read, and closed through the surface's own cancel or close button; no OK, Save, Create, Import, Export or Delete was pressed and no text was typed. The window set and the project's modification time read the same before and after every step (nav-census.py refuses to go on otherwise).
Only the surfaces nav-plan.json names were opened: a surface not in the plan is not measured by this record.
Every row read is filed under the surface its step named.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.
